name: Love Letter Duel: Long Courtship
summary: A two-player Love Letter duel over exactly 40 turns. Each turn one player draws, discards one of two cards and resolves its effect. Winning a hand earns a token; most tokens wins, with total discarded ranks as the tie-break.

player.meaning: Ranks of the cards in this player's hand: 1 card between turns, 2 during their own turn.
Ranks this player has discarded this hand, in order.
Sum of ranks discarded this hand; reset at each new hand.
Sum of all ranks discarded over the whole game, including cards a Prince forced out.
1 if protected by a Handmaid until this player's next turn starts.
1 if knocked out of the current hand.

game.meaning: Ranks of the undrawn cards; order is hidden.
Out-of-play position 1: the face-down burned card (0 or 1 rank).
Number of cards left in the deck.
1 if a new hand must be dealt at the start of the next round.
Rank the active player discards this turn.
Scratch flag: 1 if a hand was dealt this round.
Scratch flag: 1 if a token was awarded this round.

setup: Two seats are filled. Each player starts with tokens 0 and career_sum 0, an empty hand and empty discards.
The table starts with active_seat 1, hand_over 1 and round_number 0. The deck holds all 16 ranks: 1 x5, 2 x2, 3 x2, 4 x2, 5 x2, 6, 7, 8.

round.effect: When hand_over = 1: empty every hand, every player's discards, burned_card and face_up, and set deck to all 16 ranks. Draw 1 random rank from deck into burned_card, then 5 random ranks from deck into face_up. Draw 1 random rank from deck into each player's hand. Set deck_count = 8. For both players set protected = 0, eliminated = 0 and discard_sum = 0. Set hand_over = 0 and new_hand = 1.
When new_hand = 1, announce: 'The face-up out-of-play cards are ranks {face_up}.'
Set the active player's protected = 0. Move 1 random rank from deck to the active player's hand; deck_count -= 1. Privately tell the active player: 'You kept rank X and just drew rank Y.'

round.answer: one of the ranks in their hand
round.effect: Store the chosen rank in discard_choice.
Countess: if the active player's hand contains 7 and also contains 5 or 6, set discard_choice = 7.
Move one card of rank discard_choice from the active player's hand to their discards. Add discard_choice to their discard_sum and career_sum. Announce 'Seat s discards rank r (name).'
When discard_choice = 1: store the number in guess.

When discard_choice = 1: if the opponent's protected = 1, announce no effect. Otherwise, if the opponent's hand card = guess, set the opponent's eliminated = 1 and announce a hit; if not, announce a miss.
When discard_choice = 2: if the opponent's protected = 1, announce no effect. Otherwise privately tell the active player the opponent's hand rank, and announce 'Seat s looked at Seat o's card.'

When discard_choice = 3: if the opponent's protected = 1, announce no effect. Otherwise compare the two hand cards. The owner of the lower one gets eliminated = 1, and the loser and the losing rank are announced. If the cards are equal, announce a tie and nobody is out.
When discard_choice = 4: set the active player's protected = 1 and announce it.

When discard_choice = 5: the target is the opponent, or the active player if the opponent's protected = 1. Move the target's hand card to their discards, add its rank to their discard_sum and career_sum, and announce the rank. If the rank was 8, set the target's eliminated = 1. Otherwise, if deck_count > 0, move 1 random rank from deck to the target's hand and deck_count -= 1; if deck_count = 0, move the burned_card rank to the target's hand.
When discard_choice = 6: if the opponent's protected = 1, announce no effect. Otherwise swap the two players' hand lists and announce the swap.
When discard_choice = 8: set the active player's eliminated = 1 and announce it.

Showdown, when the sum of eliminated = 0 and (deck_count = 0 or round_number = 40): announce both hand ranks. The owner of the lower hand card gets eliminated = 1. If the cards are equal, the owner of the lower discard_sum gets eliminated = 1. If those are also equal, announce that the hand is tied and set hand_over = 1.

Award, when the sum of eliminated = 1: the player with eliminated = 0 gains tokens += 1, and the new total is announced. Set hand_over = 1, token_awarded = 1, and active_seat = the seat of the eliminated player.
End the game if round_number = 40; otherwise continue.

ending.decided_by: The player with more tokens wins. If tokens are equal, the higher career_sum wins. If both are equal, the players share the result as a draw.

rules.text: The deck has 16 cards: rank 1 x5, rank 2 x2, rank 3 x2, rank 4 x2, rank 5 x2, rank 6 x1, rank 7 x1, rank 8 x1.

When hand_over = 1 at the start of a round, then all 16 cards are gathered, 1 goes to burned_card, 5 go face up to face_up, each player gets 1 card, deck_count = 8, protected, eliminated and discard_sum are 0 for both players, and hand_over = 0.
When a new hand is dealt, then the 5 face_up ranks are announced and the burned card stays hidden.
When a turn starts, then the active player's protected = 0, they draw 1 card from the deck, deck_count drops by 1, and they are privately told the rank they kept and the rank they drew.
When the active player chooses a rank, then it is stored in discard_choice.
When the active player holds rank 7 together with rank 5 or rank 6, then discard_choice = 7.
When a card is discarded, then it moves to the player's discards, its rank is added to discard_sum and career_sum, and 'Seat s discards rank r (name)' is announced.
When discard_choice = 1, then the active player names a rank from 2 to 8 as guess.
When a Guard is played against a protected opponent, then it has no effect.
When a Guard's guess equals an unprotected opponent's card, then the opponent's eliminated = 1 and a hit is announced; otherwise a miss is announced.

When a Priest is played against an unprotected opponent, then the active player is privately told the opponent's rank and the look is announced publicly; against a protected opponent it has no effect.

When a Baron is played against an unprotected opponent, then the holder of the lower hand card gets eliminated = 1 and the losing rank is announced; on equal cards a tie is announced and nobody is out.
When a Handmaid is played, then the active player's protected = 1 until their next turn starts.
When a Prince is played, then its target is the opponent, or the active player if the opponent is protected.
When a Prince target discards, then the rank is added to the target's discard_sum and career_sum and announced; if it was rank 8, the target's eliminated = 1.
When a Prince target did not discard rank 8, then the target draws from the deck if deck_count > 0 (deck_count drops by 1); otherwise the target takes the burned card.
When a King is played against an unprotected opponent, then the two hand cards are swapped and the swap is announced; against a protected opponent it has no effect.
When a Princess is discarded by the active player, then their eliminated = 1.
When nobody is eliminated and (deck_count = 0 or it is round 40), then both hands are revealed and the lower card's owner gets eliminated = 1.
When showdown cards are equal, then the lower discard_sum is eliminated; if discard_sum is also equal, then the hand is tied, no token is awarded, and hand_over = 1.
When exactly one player is eliminated, then the other gains 1 token, hand_over = 1, and the eliminated player is active_seat for the next hand.
When no token was awarded in a round, then active_seat switches to the other seat.
When round 40 ends, then the game ends; more tokens wins, then higher career_sum, and if both are equal it is a draw.

offers.question: Which rank to discard
offers.options: If the hand contains 7 together with 5 or 6: only 7. Otherwise: each distinct rank in their two-card hand (one option if both cards are the same rank).

offers.question: Guard guess
offers.who: the active seat, only when discard_choice = 1

choices.why: The designer fixed the duel at 2. All card effects target 'the opponent', and the game is two-person deduction and bluffing about one hidden card.
The source has no table talk. Adding it would be a new mechanic.

choices.what: Out-of-play split into burned_card (hidden) and face_up (public)
choices.why: Position 1 is face down while positions 2-6 are face up, so they need different visibility.
career_sum can never reach 1000 in 40 rounds (at most about 16 per round), so tokens come first and career_sum breaks ties. Equal values share the win, which is the draw.

choices.what: When the hand holds 7 with 5 or 6, only 7 is offered
choices.why: A seat is never offered what it may not do. The Countess step still enforces it.

choices.what: Scratch flags new_hand, token_awarded and round_number added
choices.why: Needed to condition the face-up announcement, the pass step and the round-40 showdown with arithmetic.

simplifications.what: Deck draws are random picks from the deck list instead of taking the top card of one shuffle per hand
simplifications.why: The engine draws at random. The deck order is hidden and unseen, so each draw has the same distribution as a single shuffle.
